name: Azshara
_terrain: A 3.3.5 zone Turtle reworked: two new camps (Flaxwhisker Front, gnomes, south coast; Bloodfist Point, orcs, north-east), new NPCs and quests across the zone (Rethress naga, Keepers of Eldarath, Magus Bromley, Archmage Xylem's apprentice, the Macrochelys camp). The 3.3.5 Azshara, its NPCs and quests stay; Turtle's additions are merged in.
_merge_region: own=changed: only Azshara chunks Turtle reshaped or gave a new subzone. own_exclude_areas: The Great Sea (2321, reshaped for Moonwhisper Coast) and Timbermaw Hold / Ursolan (1216, 1225: Turtle reshaped them by up to 72 yd for the furbolg village of Winterspring's Darkwhisper Gorge and the approach to its Timbermaw Hold raid - both left for Winterspring). reshaped_skip_zones: Moonwhisper Coast (5642, a Turtle zone not ported), Hyjal (616, already merged), Winterspring, Ashenvale, Durotar (Turtle's Sparkwater Port) and the Great Sea.
_zone_from_335_tiles: Turtle's server maps miss Azshara: where Turtle did not change a tile, the zone and subzone come from the 3.3.5 tile.
_area_bits: Flaxwhisker Front 5073, Bloodfist Point 5074. (Maw of Ursoc 5633 has no ground in Turtle's tiles: not added.)
_exclude_creatures: Gazztoggle Krewpipe and Frix Tallycog: Turtle's Sparkwater Port chain (55007 starts at Sparkwater Port in Durotar, new Turtle land not ported). Sentinel Velaya: her only quest goes to Moonwhisper Coast. Grathnol and Darg: the Azshara edge of Winterspring's furbolg village (their ground is left out with it).
_exclude_quests: 55007-55018 Sparkwater Port chain; 40033 Finding Akh Z'ador (Sanv K'la gives it; built with the Swamp of Sorrows, which ports her chain - Akh Z'ador's own 41320-41323 follow it here); Akh Z'ador's 41324/41325 (goes to Kas'tal in the Blasted Lands); 41651 (Hidden Locker, follows 41650 elsewhere, ends at Zappo Zapblast in Winterspring); 42063 (to Moonwhisper Coast). 41900-41904 the Sapta quests of Grathnol (left out with the furbolg village).
_extra_creature_templates: Quest credit dummies (Turtle's quest_*_dummy_triger): 40124, 40068, 40247, 40253, 40285, 40289, 40293, 40295; the Amplified and Volatile Arcane Monstrosities the Resonating Pedestal summons (41315).
_extra_gameobject_spawns: The Sunken Locker on the sea floor south of the Bay of Storms (The Gyronautical Compass, 40064).
_left_out: 41345 Altar of an Ancient Evil (Altar of Cla'ckora) and 41395 A Hidden Compartment (Pedestal Plaque): object-started quests whose required items (Ancient Idol of Cla'ckora; Palatinate, Cobalt and Cardinal Shards) have no source anywhere in Turtle's DB, and the plaque has no spawn. 41935 Rite of Resurrection is started by an item.
